title: On factorial reciprocals in Cantor sets
summary: Let $C$ be the middle-third Cantor set. We show that \[\left\{\frac{1}{n!}: n\in\mathbb{N}\right\}\cap C=\left\{1, \frac{1}{5!}\right\}.\] This answers a question recently posed by Jiang [J. Lond. Math. Soc., 113(1):e70408, 2026]. Our approach extends to general missing-digit sets, showing that, in any such set, there are only finitely many elements of the form $\frac{1}{n!}$, all of which can be effectively determined.
